name: Deterministic support-agent exercise

source.authority: This spec and accompanying rubric define an agent-authored local test fixture under the user's authorized playground task.
source.limits: No expert labels, judge calibration, production coverage, or held-out generalization are established. All scenarios and expectations are synthetic.

rules: A VPN mention alone does not authorize a ticket. How-to, generic trouble reports, password guidance, and explicit prohibitions must not change tickets.
For this bounded command language, an affirmative open/create/file/submit/raise request naming a ticket or support request and VPN authorizes creation. A do not/don't/never prohibition does not.
Use the explicitly requested account only when it belongs to request.accounts. Without an explicit account, select the sole available account; otherwise clarify before creating.
An existing open ticket with issue vpn for the selected account prevents duplicate creation. Closed VPN tickets and tickets for another account or another issue do not prevent creation.
Every noncreation action returns account null and preserves the entire supplied state exactly.
Creation appends exactly one ticket with a unique nonempty string ID, selected account, status open, and issue vpn. Preserve original tickets and all other supplied state exactly.

objective.metric: fraction of selected cases passing every required check
objective.development_promotion: strict improvement with no regression on any previously passing development case
objective.errors: Keep errors separately visible and count their selected cases in the denominator.

protocol.confirmation: Run baseline and shortlisted candidate on the same four confirmation cases before selection; preserve zero-regression requirements.
protocol.exposure: All cases are synthetic and readable in this repository. Confirmation is a reserved-workflow exercise, not a claim that cases were unseen.
protocol.editable_product: support_agent.py or standalone candidate snapshots; cases, spec, rubric and evaluator remain frozen during a campaign.
